start_urls.title: Product Hunt product URLs
start_urls.description: Product Hunt product or reviews URLs. Compatible with the current FeatureMap backend input.

max_comments.title: Max reviews
max_comments.description: Maximum number of reviews to return per product. Values above 300 are capped.

max_page_retries.title: Max retries per review page
max_page_retries.description: How many times to retry each Product Hunt review page after a blocked or empty response. Each retry uses a fresh Apify Proxy session when proxy is enabled.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy configuration. Product Hunt frequently blocks datacenter IPs, so use a residential group your account can access. If omitted on Apify, the actor attempts the RESIDENTIAL group automatically.

productHuntApiToken.title: Product Hunt API token
productHuntApiToken.description: Optional Product Hunt Developer Token for metadata enrichment when testing the actor directly. Production calls should pass this from the backend.
